title: FlowPilot AI — Premium AI SaaS Dashboard
short_description: A premium AI-inspired SaaS productivity demo featuring an interactive dashboard, project organization, task management, pricing plans, and responsive UI.
description: FlowPilot AI is a modern, responsive SaaS portfolio demonstration built with React 19, Vite, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. It combines a polished marketing website with an interactive productivity dashboard featuring local task management, project overviews, lightweight insights, simulated account sessions, and predefined AI-style suggestions. The project also includes responsive navigation, educational blog content, accessible UI components, and illustrative subscription pricing. All AI responses, account sessions, and subscription features are demonstrations; no real AI processing, authentication, or billing occurs.
